extracted.intended_audience: general newspaper readers and journalists interested in wartime coverage
extracted.subtask_description: Reporting and dissemination of news during wartime (names, casualty lists, raids, official statements), with attention to operational security, timeliness, and public morale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational security in public information
rubrics_metrics.description: "No information should be given that could be relayed and be of use to our enemies."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as a guiding principle: withhold details that would aid the enemy; release only what cannot be exploited strategically. (Context: cited in discussion of government/news release practices during wartime.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency balanced with security
rubrics_metrics.description: "The Government should give us full and frank information regardless whether good or bad, just as soon as it can be given without helping the enemy."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance for authorities/journalists: provide truthful, prompt information whenever it can be released without compromising operations. Emphasizes candor subject to operational-security constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid long withholding of unpleasant news
rubrics_metrics.description: "Information that is withheld for a great length of time and then released in conjunction with news of successes naturally arouses in the public mind the conclusion that unpleasant news was withheld, not for strategic reasons, but to cushion later news."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical caution: long delays in releasing adverse information (especially when paired with later positive announcements) undermine public trust and suggest deception; prefer timely disclosure consistent with security needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protecting national morale through truthful reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: "Nothing could be more disastrous to national morale than to engender suspicion among our people that they are being deceived as to the facts."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Normative standard: to preserve public morale, reporting and official statements should avoid the appearance or reality of deception; maintain credibility by being as open as security permits.
